key_facts: In fiscal year 2025, FEMA employed about 25,134 employees, on average.
Over 4,300 employees separated from FEMA in fiscal year 2025—a 55 percent increase in separations from fiscal year 2024.
In 2025, FEMA rescinded its strategic plan, leaving the agency without overall strategic direction for workforce planning.
FEMA did not base its 2025 and 2026 workforce reduction decisions on the results of a workforce analysis.
GAO added strengthening FEMA's disaster workforce and capacity to its High Risk List in February 2025.
